known_issues: The existing 300-second post-admission acceptance budget is shared by launch admission, direct-worker waits and terminal acceptance. Each wait uses the shorter stage limit or remaining job time; the existing 2-second cleanup budget is separate. Parent work, process creation and syscalls are not preempted, so this is not a hard whole-job deadline.
Counts are spent launch attempts and reserved child ceilings, never observed process counts or successful execution attestations.

For P admitted pages, T=ceil(P/16) and R=ceil(P/4): direct=21+T+R, reserved=R+P, composed=21+T+2R+P. At 64 pages these are 41+80=121 below the coordinator; an optional fixed supervisor adds one, giving 122.

Each raster parent reserves one probe plus its exact selected pages. The unchanged PR133 raster worker budget enforces those downstream attempts; arbitrary descendants and replacement Python forging receipts are not authenticated.

Bounded pread binds the exact declared ASCII header and observable descriptor identity without reading or rehashing the PDF body. Adversarial concurrent mutation, including mutate-and-restore, is unsupported.
A foreign PID rejects its inherited copied state before the lock. Poisoning a child's memory does not poison the parent copy.
The fixed worker and default rendering/QA route are outside this scope. document_plan.py legacy estimates remain unchanged and are distinct from this cumulative attempt ceiling.
No aggregate CPU, RSS, scratch, descriptors, hard wall-time, arbitrary-descendant resource qualification, default activation or release authority is established.
